title: Queued-send burst performance characterization verification
preconditions: The exact queued-send actuation lineage and queued-send performance specification remain present.
Performance acceptance authorization, active behavior authorization, and production activation remain false.
The ProtocolLab raw QUIC package path is available for package-backed execution.
The queued-send gate workload quic.transport.stream-download.1mb remains supported.
verification_method: Validate the canonical JSON, compile the queued-send campaign deterministically, inspect the fixed two-cell schedule, execute the package-backed ProtocolLab path, review bounded aggregate evidence, and check that the result remains descriptive rather than promotional.

supplemental_sections.heading: Scope
supplemental_sections.content: Verify the exact two-cell queued-send performance authority, the eight-block / 16-job deterministic campaign, the package-backed ProtocolLab execution path, the stream-throughput gate proof, resumability, bounded aggregate evidence, and the non-accepting descriptive result.

status_summary: Passed. The exact control hash cb80a3309d792443e903657746c2be0a7931a838f1bf37eba4b84ff727bcc382 and manifest hash 2ad809ecdb882f000c38d00c97f69604cbb3e004186535fd2348800e7c8a27ab compiled deterministically to eight alternating two-position blocks and 16 jobs. A separate preflight on plab-worker-x64-02 and plab-worker-x64-03 proved predicate.queued_send.legal_budget_gt_one with 19,455 activations. All 16 timed rows completed from clean source 5bd4b4d2ddbb027bee534392dca2a2518f8fa935 with exact transferred bytes, zero failed attempts, zero request failures, zero timeouts, no detected saturation, and per-row output below the 65,536-byte cap. Canonical result 1c02b545e1714079fc12f6f46bba502c5f5c661dbf5883a2591774cbfe9979 replayed byte-for-byte and reports legacy_current at 26.9473 mean requests per second / 46.7691 ms mean p95 and single_datagram at 1.7960 / 596.1500. The single_datagram result was worse in every block, but the campaign remains characterization-only with performance acceptance, rule derivation, winner selection, covering-array generation, active behavior, and production activation false.
scope: Verify the exact two-cell queued-send performance slice, the deterministic two-position campaign shape, the ProtocolLab package-backed execution path, the gate precondition for accepted single_datagram timing rows, the resumable bounded evidence model, and the non-accepting analysis boundary.
procedure: Validate the queued-send performance SpecTrace JSON against the published schema.
Compile the queued-send performance campaign twice and confirm the eight-block, two-position schedule is byte-identical.
Confirm the campaign contains exactly 16 jobs and 8 repetitions per cell.
Prove the quic.transport.stream-download.1mb gate establishes predicate.queued_send.legal_budget_gt_one before accepting single_datagram timing rows.
Execute the package-backed ProtocolLab path and confirm resumable attempt accounting and bounded aggregate evidence.
Review the result and confirm that no adaptive rule, winner, active behavior, or production activation is produced.
expected_result: The queued-send performance slice remains exactly two cells wide, deterministic, package-backed, resumable, and descriptively bounded; gate failure keeps single_datagram timing rows unaccepted; and the result stays non-promoting.
